themes: Indonesia's young, mobile-first population drives durable demand for e-commerce and fintech services, insulating local tech from global rate sensitivity.

Accumulate on dips in local e-commerce and fintech plays, as structural demand from a young, mobile-first population remains intact.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's new administration is accelerating the Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP) funding, driving near-term demand for geothermal and solar projects with state-backed offtake.
Captive industrial demand from nickel smelters and data centers is creating a structural tailwind for independent power producers (IPPs) offering baseload renewables like geothermal and biomass.
Domestic content requirements (TKDN) for solar module manufacturing are spurring local production capacity, reducing import dependency and improving margins for domestic climate-tech firms.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables sector shows a WATCH signal with a -1.11% aggregate decline, but selective movers like 1211 (+3.51%) and TPIA (+2.87%) indicate capital rotating into specific names. Focus on regulatory catalysts from the new government's energy transition roadmap and captive industrial demand for solar and biomass. Position for policy-driven re-rating in geothermal and waste-to-energy plays.
